sections.title: Executive Verdict

FY26 revenue was ₹60.63 crore and PAT ₹6.92 crore, but operating cash becomes negative ₹14.31 crore after separating borrowing inflows and fixed-deposit deployment correctly. sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Curis Lifesciences Limited, ISIN INE1BZN01016, NSE Emerge CURIS; listed 14 November 2025. Review cutoff: 20 October 2026. Accounts are standalone Indian GAAP financial statements under Accounting Standards (AS), not Ind AS. Official 19 October close is ₹190.10 in traded series ST, not a live quote. Issued shares are 8,084,434, verified through capital reconciliation and the IPO. Historical statement confidence is medium after explicit normalization; current funding and executable liquidity are low. G1–G4 are Conditional, not automatic failures. ESM Stage I is a market-surveillance condition, not proof of issuer wrongdoing.

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: Factors are GOV 4, MOAT 4, REV 7, DUR 6, CAP 4, CASH 2, BAL 4, EXEC 4 and EARN 4. BQS is 4.36. Raw Growth Quality GQS is 5.40, capped at 5.00 because weak CASH conversion is persistent across FY24–FY26, not merely one expansion year. R and L are NS; D is 3 and P is 4. IAS retains its original weights and exact bounds, without redistributing missing weights. The reporting corrections affect relevant governance/earnings judgments; they do not arbitrarily suppress every quality factor. Scored factors are analyst judgments with explicit counterevidence.

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Curis manufactures tablets, capsules, external preparations, oral liquids and sterile ophthalmic ointments, with contract-manufacturing and registration/documentation activity. FY26 manufactured-goods sales were ₹59.1185 crore, direct export goods ₹0.0129 crore and dossier/document charges ₹1.0305 crore; indirect overseas end-use must not be relabeled as direct exports. Product quality, registrations, customer approvals and inventory expiry matter more than a broad pharmaceutical-market narrative. July 2025 product mix was nearly 88% tablets, so apparently unused liquid/capsule capacity is not automatically interchangeable with tablet demand. The Nigerian associate acquired later is a separate distribution opportunity, not an operating subsidiary inside FY26 accounts.

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Multiple dosage forms and product documentation support customer qualification, but no proprietary drug or strong consumer-brand economics were established. Windlas is a larger CDMO comparator rather than an interchangeable valuation peer: FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹904.09 crore, PAT ₹66.46 crore, CFO ₹104.93 crore and cash capex ₹67.66 crore. Its positive cash conversion contrasts with Curis’s present cash absorption. Different scale, customer mix, accounting and growth investments prevent importing a peer P/E without adjustment. Curis’s concentrated contract base and need to fund registrations limit bargaining power. Manufacturing capability is real; durable pricing power remains unproven.

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Restated operating revenue was ₹35.4488/₹35.5557/₹49.1324 crore in FY23/FY24/FY25. FY26 reported operating revenue ₹60.6288 crore includes ₹0.0007 crore FX; normalized operating revenue ₹60.6281 crore gives a 19.59% three-year CAGR and REV 7. FY25 statutory revenue ₹50.2586 crore includes ₹0.50 crore commission, ₹0.6259 crore creditor write-off and ₹0.0003 crore FX that explain the difference from restated operations. The prospectus separately reconciles prior-period write-offs, deferred tax and other profit adjustments; they are not silently treated as new recurring sales. Top-ten customers contributed 87.23% in FY25 and 97.20% in the four months to July 2025. Those dated figures are concentration warnings, not a measured FY26 customer mix.

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: Inventory grew ₹15.71 crore to ₹34.11 crore, exceeding half of annual revenue. Receivables increased to ₹11.22 crore and include ₹3.43 crore overdue more than one year. Business advances are ₹4.84 crore and capital advances ₹0.406 crore; their precise deployment and recovery need verification. The IPO raised ₹27.52 crore gross at ₹128 for 21.5 lakh new shares, with ₹23.9237 crore reported net financing cash. March utilisation records the ₹11.25 crore working-capital object as spent, while upgrade, storage and registration budget balances total ₹7.7556 crore. That certificate does not equal free cash: ₹0.7963 crore issue-cost overspend was not allowed to create a negative unutilized line, and advances are recognized as used only when invoices/assets are booked. Upgrades improve quality/productivity, not installed nameplate capacity. The model credits the known capital advance once and separately tests whether business advances cover remaining project cash costs.

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Three executives each received ₹0.125 crore, compared with ₹0.06 crore previously. Promoter/relative unsecured funding supports the business but requires clear terms and repayment priority. Biocare Formulation is director-related; FY26 loan amounts paid and received were both ₹0.1535 crore, with smaller purchase/sale transactions, so these gross flows are not labeled an unexplained outstanding promoter loan. The July exchange fine was ₹5,000 plus GST for one day’s delay in RPT disclosure; the board attributed it to portal errors. That small procedural event is not a critical integrity gate. The independent-director and secretary departures cite other commitments, not an asserted accounting dispute. The August Nigerian investment buys 49.95% for ₹5 lakh in a zero-turnover distribution company; no future revenue or profit is credited merely because the deal was announced.

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: Reported FY26 CFO of −₹16.416 crore includes +₹7.8923 crore short-term borrowing and −₹10 crore FD deployment. Removing borrowing from CFO and adding it to financing gives CFO −₹24.3083 crore; moving the FD outflow from CFO to investing produces operating CFO −₹14.3083 crore. Adjusted investing cash is −₹11.5885 crore and financing +₹28.7584 crore, preserving net cash increase ₹2.8616 crore. After ₹1.8019 crore cash capex, the operating FCF proxy is −₹16.1102 crore. The six AMCO FDs mature December 2026 and explicitly secure ₹8.8481 crore FD overdraft. Gross debt totals ₹21.5909 crore; cash ₹3.1651 crore includes ₹0.4 crore escrow. Original PDF page 84 verifies that EPS ₹37.14 uses 1,852,902 shares while the same note’s FY26 weighted-share reconciliation totals 6,741,420; its PAT ₹6.8811 crore also differs slightly from P&L ₹6.9163 crore. Published EPS is excluded. Current-share earnings are about ₹8.56, not an audited weighted EPS. July’s exchange response corrects taxonomy, reserve omission and attachment format, not this substantive EPS inconsistency. These observations warrant correction but do not establish missing cash or fraud.

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: At official ₹190.10 and 8,084,434 shares, market capitalization is ₹153.69 crore, about 22.2× current-share reported earnings and 3.25× book equity ₹47.36 crore. A P/E calculated using published EPS ₹37.14 would be materially misleading. Bear/base/bull models use annual growth 3%/12%/20%, margins 14%/18%/20%, NWC 85%/70%/60% of revenue and exit EV/EBITDA 7/10/13. Sales are capped at 1.5× current revenue in bear/base and 2× in bull; the latter requires a mix shift toward underutilized forms, not invented nameplate expansion. Every annual row links registration expense, project and maintenance capex, FD release/overdraft repayment, interest, taxes, borrowing, repayment and dilution. Terminal prices are approximately ₹77/₹217/₹418, with annual returns −16.6%/2.7%/17.1%. These are conditional sensitivities, not actionable targets. The base requires improved cash conversion and collateral settlement; unresolved advance purpose and bank headroom keep R NS. New borrowing now carries half-year interest; ordinary repayments occur at year-end. Interest, tax and required draws are solved jointly. Curis’s collateral-funded overdraft repayment retains half-year timing.

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: The key risk is not simply a low reported margin: stock and advances can fail to convert into cash while bank interest and project obligations continue. Loss of a large tablet customer, aged-debtor impairment, product-quality problems or delayed registrations can turn inventory into a financing burden. The severe model combines falling sales, a 10% margin, NWC equal to annual sales, 14% debt cost, no FD release and an aged-receivable loss. Separate tests apply a 25% inventory haircut, lower margin, slower WC conversion, capex overrun and dilution without credited proceeds. Positive book equity and FD collateral are counterweights, but encumbered cash cannot simultaneously repay debt and fund expansion. Hypothetical funding requirements are not presented as an observed default.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At unchanged shares, fivefold or tenfold prices require about ₹768 crore or ₹1,537 crore equity value. At an illustrative 20× P/E and 10% sustainable net margin, that implies approximately ₹384 crore or ₹768 crore annual sales, versus ₹60.63 crore now. Current product concentration and unchanged nameplate capacity do not establish that outcome. Further growth would require usable capacity, product/customer diversification, collections and funding that do not repeatedly dilute owners. The small zero-turnover Nigerian stake is optionality, not an economic bridge to these targets.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Track inventory by age, form and confirmed customer order, with expiry/write-down exposure. Obtain subsequent collections for the ₹3.43 crore receivables more than one year overdue and identify the purpose/counterparties of ₹4.84 crore business advances. Reconcile IPO expenditure to actual bank cash, overdraft collateral and invoices. Verify December FD settlement or renewal and contemporaneous facility limits. Request corrected EPS and share-weighting disclosures without treating a corrected denominator as improved operating profit. Monitor registration and storage completion, not just budget allocation. Official data shows 49 traded observations in the 60-session window and 11 unclassified gaps; conditional zero-fill produces about 8.86 days at 5% participation, but this is not asserted actual liquidity. One 1,000-share lot costs ₹190,100; ESM Stage I and fewer-than-100-PAN/irregular-trading flags reinforce execution caution.

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Completed deep review, with a working-capital, reporting-controls and funding hold for investment purposes. BQS 4.36 and GQS capped at 5.00 do not support treating this as a demonstrated cash compounder. IAS is NS, not zero, because expected-return and full tradability evidence remain incomplete. No purchase, allocation or exit instruction is proposed. Reconsider only after stock/receivable conversion, usable cash and facility headroom are evidenced, remaining project costs are funded and the per-share reporting is corrected.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary research covers FY26 annual financials, the final prospectus and historical restatements, July exchange clarification, March IPO-utilisation certificate, later JV and management filings, official NSE price/history and decoded surveillance. Original EPS layout was visually checked before describing the inconsistency. Windlas primary financials provide limited economic comparison. The standalone curis_funded_model.json and embedded valuation contain annual operating/WC/capex/debt/FD/interest/dilution and terminal-equity bridges plus sensitivities. Remaining gaps are post-March cash/credit utilisation, business-advance purpose, stock recoverability, capacity/product mix and the 11 missing market observations. Missing inputs constrain the relevant factors and are not placeholders for unperformed applicable analysis.
